decaying_aftermath.body.head: Head
decaying_aftermath.medical.apply_hint: Click item, release, then left/right-click a body part
decaying_aftermath.inventory.title: Medical inventory
decaying_aftermath.procedure.title: Medical procedure
decaying_aftermath.procedure.cancel: Esc: leave; used material is not restored
decaying_aftermath.procedure.guide.wrap: Grab the roll and wind clockwise. Multiple layers provide gradual bleed care. Keep winding; the percentage is remaining material.
decaying_aftermath.procedure.guide.syrin: LMB: align and insert the needle. Hold RMB for the plunger, then withdraw straight.
decaying_aftermath.procedure.guide.potio: LMB: bring the bottle to the wound. Mouse wheel: tilt; keep the pouring angle steady.
decaying_aftermath.procedure.guide.splin: Align the splint with both marks. Mouse wheel: rotate. Release to fit.
Thread each strap to the right, then pull it left to tension. Stay on the rail.
decaying_aftermath.procedure.guide.tourn: Place the tourniquet between the marks, then release.
Thread the strap to the right, then grasp the windlass and turn it clockwise three times.
decaying_aftermath.thought.supply_space: Need room for the unused items.
decaying_aftermath.hint.antibiotics: Hold RMB to swallow. Gradual systemic infection control; excessive use adds toxicity. Fictional game quantities.
decaying_aftermath.hint.painkillers: Hold RMB to swallow. Reduces pain, not wounds. Adds to opioid burden and overdose risk.
decaying_aftermath.hint.coagulant: Hold RMB to swallow. Supports clotting over time; does not replace lost blood. Excess is toxic.
decaying_aftermath.hint.water_bottle: Hold RMB to drink. Absorption takes time; leaves an empty bottle.
decaying_aftermath.hint.dirty_water_bott: Crouch-use a glass bottle at water to collect. Biological contamination can cause delayed gut infection. Boil this water first.
decaying_aftermath.hint.coffee: Hold RMB to drink. Temporary stimulant effect; does not recreate energy, blood or tissue. Repetition adds toxicity.
decaying_aftermath.hint.pemmican: Hold RMB to eat. Supplies vanilla hunger and metabolic nutrition, never instant wound healing.
decaying_aftermath.thought.not_needed: This procedure is not needed here.
decaying_aftermath.procedure.guide.tool: Drag the tool onto the marked game body region and hold steady. Esc cancels; completed extraction wears the tool once.
decaying_aftermath.report.vitals: Blood %s%%; O2 %s%%; water %s%%; nutrition %s%%; body %s C; load %s%%; red cells %s%%; plasma %s%%
decaying_aftermath.hint.naloxone: Apply through the medical panel. Temporarily blocks opioid effects without removing the drug; effects can return as the block wears off.
decaying_aftermath.hint.combatpen: Apply through the medical panel. A fictional stimulant mixture, not pure adrenaline; no blood or tissue regeneration.
decaying_aftermath.hint.blood_bag: Apply through the medical panel. Replaces plasma and red cells. Compatibility is a declared game assumption; no real blood groups or doses.
decaying_aftermath.hint.saline: Apply through the medical panel. Replaces plasma volume only; cannot restore lost red cells or oxygen-carrying capacity.
decaying_aftermath.hint.ice_pack: Game medical panel: a burn or bruise, never frostbite or hypothermia. Temporary comfort, not instant tissue repair.
decaying_aftermath.hint.chest_drain: Game medical panel: torso only, for a puncture-associated collapsed lung. Recovery remains gradual.
decaying_aftermath.hint.tweezers: Game medical panel: remove an embedded projectile. Reusable; one durability point per completed extraction, no wear on cancellation.
decaying_aftermath.hint.backpack: Equip in the chest slot. Adds carrying capacity, not free mass or extra slots; nested contents still weigh something.
